## Our Story

**In January 2023, Ungerboeck rebranded to Momentus Technologies** to unify the organization and vertical-specific software under one vision to meet the dynamically changing needs of the venue and event management industry.

This was a critical step in our company’s history after the acquisitions of EventBooking, Priava, Showorks and Risk Manager two years prior. Today, our brand represents what we’ve become since we started on this path — a portfolio of brilliant people, modern technology and science-backed solutions to provide our customers with the best solutions for venue and event management.

## Our Core Values

Leading by example sets us apart. Our core values inspire our leaders and teams to build extraordinary solutions for you. It is these five values which guide our organization in everything we do, from product development to customer interactions.

### Speed

Fast is better than slow – without compromising on quality.

### Humility

Constantly look to improve and never forget the importance of our customers and colleagues.

### Passion

Strive for excellence, go the extra mile and have fun doing it.

### Innovation

Take risks, encourage current and new ideas, learn from mistakes, and consistently strive to exceed expectations.

### Focus

Focus on a few things and be the best.

### Global Footprint

Our solution diversity combined with our global scale and deep understanding of our markets allows for better innovation to meet our customers evolving venue and event management needs.

## Our Leadership Team

Meet the team that will guide our company — and industry — into the future.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c329da6dd401b7909256_alex-alexandrov.avif)

Alex Alexandrov

Chief Executive Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c329da6dd401b7909256_alex-alexandrov.avif)

Chief Executive Officer

Alex Alexandrov

Alex leads the strategic direction for Momentus. He is focused on building a team of passionate Momentus colleagues, ensuring the organization delivers on its value proposition to customers, accelerating innovation, and continuing fast-paced global growth. Prior to this role, he served as a member of the executive board, chief operating officer and president of the Latin American region for SoftwareONE. During his tenure there, Alex was instrumental in driving profitable growth, industrializing global shared service centers, building an M&A and post-merger integration program with 20 acquisitions, and driving internal digital transformation. He also led the company’s successful IPO in 2019. Previously, Alex was a managing director at Thomas H. Lee Partners. He started his career at Goldman, Sachs & Co. Alex holds bachelor’s degrees in finance and economics from the University of Texas at Austin and an MBA from Harvard Business School. Alex lives in Austin with his family and enjoys running, and organizing his collection of hoodies.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6ad7c891c6ceee5f2dd573b9_Nesbitt%20Headshot.png)

Tyler Nesbitt

Chief of Staff

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6ad7c891c6ceee5f2dd573b9_Nesbitt%20Headshot.png)

Chief of Staff

Tyler Nesbitt

Tyler drives executive priorities, cross-functional initiatives and leadership alignment at Momentus. He also supports execution of annual planning, board meetings, and internal communications. Before joining Momentus, Tyler spent nearly seven years at Highspot, a sales enablement technology company, in a variety of post-sales roles culminating in his time as Chief of Staff for the 200+ person post-sales organization and supported the team through it’s multi-billion-dollar exit. Earlier in his career, he was a management consultant at PwC, where he advised large technology and media companies on engagements ranging from mergers and acquisitions to financial analysis and ERP selection and implementation. Tyler holds a degree in Business Administration from the University of Washington. A Seattle native, he lives there today with his wife Sarah and their daughter. Outside of work, he enjoys cheering on Seattle sports teams, running, cycling, and game nights.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/69b85b79cd87ef1142a1ef54_AG_website_with%20background.avif)

Alex Griffis

Chief Product Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/69b85b79cd87ef1142a1ef54_AG_website_with%20background.avif)

Chief Product Officer

Alex Griffis

Alex leads the product management, user experience, and product marketing functions at Momentus. He is energized by partnering with our amazing customers to drive new innovative solutions that deliver massive value and help shape the events management industry. Prior to joining Momentus, Alex was the VP & General Manager for CRM and AI solutions at RealPage. Before that, he served as SVP of Product at Unanet. He lives in Denver, CO and when not working, he is spending time with his wife and daughter, hiking in the Rocky Mountains, watching movies, or scratching that competitive itch in a video game.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c29be19dc5ad371962cf_james-hughes.avif)

James Hughes

Chief Technology Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c29be19dc5ad371962cf_james-hughes.avif)

Chief Technology Officer

James Hughes

James is responsible for the global software engineering teams, technology roadmap, as well as the security and development operations teams. Over the past 20 years James has managed all aspects of software delivery including development, support, product management, integrations, and security operations. He also has extensive experience in merger & acquisition (M&A) and has successfully integrated multiple products and teams. Prior to joining Momentus, James was the CTO of Therapy Brands where he was responsible for all aspects of product development and integration of various acquisitions products and teams, with the result being a successful transaction with KKR. James also worked at Epiq Systems for many years beginning as a software engineer and ending as the vice president of product development responsible for overall global product development teams. James has a degree from Missouri State University and resides in Kansas City, Missouri with his wife and two kids.‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c25f7bfc6b0623e90772_jenn-keirnan.avif)

Jenn Keirnan

Chief Customer Officer

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c25f7bfc6b0623e90772_jenn-keirnan.avif)

Chief Customer Officer

Jenn Keirnan

Jenn is responsible for the global professional services and customer support organizations. She is passionate about running global, cross-functional teams focused on delivering high customer satisfaction and fast time-to-value for customers. Jenn is especially adept at identifying opportunities and implementing sustainable processes to streamline productivity, minimize risk and increase revenue. Prior to joining Momentus, Jenn was the vice president of global professional services & technical support for Khoros. Before that, she served as vice president of professional services for OpenSymmetry. In her free time, you can find Jenn on the lake, traveling or enjoying live music.‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c23a5596d71f2fa30b36_steve-mackenzie.avif)

Steve Mackenzie

Chief Innovation Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c23a5596d71f2fa30b36_steve-mackenzie.avif)

Chief Innovation Officer

Steve Mackenzie

Steve leads the Innovation Lab for Momentus. He works closely with customers and partners to educate them on industry best practices, gain a deeper understanding of the evolving market landscape and enhance the company’s offerings. Steve has 38 years of experience within the hospitality and events industry, 29 of them focused on the technology side of the business. He was president at EventBooking prior to the acquisition by Ungerboeck and served as Ungerboeck’s executive vice president. He’s also held leadership roles in event tech companies including Oracle (formerly Micros-Fidelio) and Stova (formerly Aventri/etouches). In 2022, Steve was awarded the Outstanding Contribution Award at the Event Tech Live Awards and inducted to its Hall of Fame. He is also a Certified Venue Executive through IAVM, holds many volunteer roles within the industry, and is an adjunct professor at Florida International University. A truly global citizen, Steve has lived and worked in multiple countries and currently resides in St. Louis, Missouri with his wife Liz and their very spoiled dachshund, Oscar. ‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c1dc6c452fb1589a12a0_jen-naegele.avif)

Jen Naegele

Chief Financial Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c1dc6c452fb1589a12a0_jen-naegele.avif)

Chief Financial Officer

Jen Naegele

Jen leads the finance organization at Momentus and is responsible for financial strategy, reporting and operations. She is focused on aligning financial discipline with innovation—connecting teams, strategy and technology to drive smart growth and build lasting value. Prior to joining Momentus, Jen served as CFO of the Private Cloud business unit at Rackspace Technology. Before that, she held a variety of corporate finance roles across multiple industries, gaining deep expertise in strategic planning, forecasting, and operational execution. Jen holds a bachelor’s degree in finance and management from Trinity University. Based in New Braunfels, Texas, she stays busy with her two kids and spends most weekends at the ball fields as a dedicated baseball and softball mom. When not at the fields, she enjoys traveling and relaxing at the beach.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6a73ae2c97ff177d0d5d66fd_dax-powers.avif)

Dax Powers

Chief Revenue Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6a73ae2c97ff177d0d5d66fd_dax-powers.avif)

Chief Revenue Officer

Dax Powers

Dax leads the global sales organization at Momentus, overseeing revenue and go-to-market strategy. With over 15 years of experience in enterprise technology and sales, Dax has contributed to the success of both large global technology enterprises and leading SaaS companies. Dax is dedicated to fostering a high-performance sales culture, refining Momentus’ go-to-market strategy, and driving repeatable, scalable sales processes. Prior to joining Momentus, he served as Vice President of Software and Cloud Solutions for the Americas at SoftwareONE, where he transformed the business from $10 million to $100 million in revenue. He also held the role of Vice President of Sales for the South and Latin America at Flexera, and he began his career with Dell. Dax holds dual bachelor’s degrees in marketing and business management from Lipscomb University. Based in Nashville, he enjoys spending time with his family, lifting weights, cheering for Florida State Seminoles football, and supporting the Nashville Predators. ‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c0ac1d259bf681756811_kirsten-schreiter.avif)

Kirsten Schreiter

Chief People Officer

[Read bio](https://gomomentus.com/about-us#)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68734d7eaec6e398c11a5a42/6980c0ac1d259bf681756811_kirsten-schreiter.avif)

Chief People Officer

Kirsten Schreiter

Kirsten leads the people & culture function, overseeing the global talent strategy for Momentus. With 20+ years' experience in diverse operating environments and all areas of human resources, she brings a unique perspective to the function and people approach. Kirsten brings keen insights and excels at identifying and encouraging constructive behavioral norms. Before joining Momentus, she served as Vice President of People & Culture for Zelis, Senior Director of Organizational Effectiveness and Transformation at Greenway Health, and a variety of roles at the Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company. Kirsten has a bachelor's degree in human resources and marketing from the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh and an MBA from Indiana Wesleyan University. In her free time she enjoys spending time with her family and 3 dogs, going to the beach and chasing down new experiences; whatever they might be.‍
